HV.reason: Upper Volta legacy designation; Burkina Faso today

methodology.universe: 249 ISO-3166-1 jurisdictions plus XK Kosovo research exception, including uninhabited and dependent territories. This is not a count of 250 countries that must contain a church.
methodology.categories: Each canonical physical Place contributes to exactly one place_type. Shrine, pilgrimage, relic and apparition domain records overlap Places and are never added to the physical-site count.
methodology.r70: May include already published candidates; 750 is a candidate-record count, not gaps.
methodology.r80_r82: 187 source mentions, including duplicates and references to already published Places; not distinct unlisted sites.
methodology.tlm: 1879 provisional TLM map venue rows; no inference of current 1962 liturgy or exact Place–Directory crosswalk.
methodology.country_category_completeness: All countries NOT_ASSESSED; no nationally comprehensive Catholic institution/category review certified. Zero records does not assert zero Catholic sites.
